review_scope: Five original images per ID, individually inspected with vision; no boards substituted.

findings.verdict_scope: Visual comparison pass with disclosed finish limitations; not final approval.
findings.hardware: Brass corner caps, long central clasp, round front disc and left ring remain consistent with marketing; gray irregular feet visible. Open screenshots reveal portions of rear hinge hardware and a released upright latch, not a demonstrated detachment.
findings.terrain: Marketing and closed runtime retain three low green banks in turquoise water with fine umbrella papyrus. Stylized plants can read as miniature palms; water reads as a flat inset rather than flowing wetland channels.
findings.texture_and_promotional_finish: Promotional lighting is softer and the body paler; runtime has stronger regular woven/ribbed marks. This is a finish/readability difference, not evidence of changed geometry. Silt material reads as reed/wood-like fibre.
findings.mobile_and_open_observations: Both mobile poses fully framed. Papyrus crowns become very delicate; hardware has limited contrast against the body. Open desktop/mobile expose patterned liner and green rim; top wetland is occluded behind the raised lid.
limitations: Cannot establish botanical/geographic fidelity from stylized terrain.
Fine stalk count and bearing contact cannot be resolved at mobile scale.

findings.verdict_scope: Visual comparison pass with disclosed finish limitations; not final approval.

limitations: No spectral pearl or historical craft equivalence established.
Still views cannot resolve every latch bearing or rear attachment.

findings.verdict_scope: Visual comparison pass with disclosed finish limitations; not final approval.
findings.hardware: Gold corner fittings, bulky front clasp, round front fitting, side ring and dark block feet consistent across promotional and runtime views. Rear hinge pieces visible open; released latch projects above lid without demonstrated failure.

findings.texture_and_promotional_finish: Scarlet/silver/brass identity preserved. Marketing gives softer, polished reflections; runtime red finish has dense diagonal/rippled texture that can read woven rather than smooth enamel. Black seam remains prominent. Finish disparity is not a geometry defect.

limitations: No claim of playable or tuned steelpans.
Hidden pans in front-open stills do not demonstrate missing ornaments; ownership/motion checks are reported context, not re-executed here.

findings.verdict_scope: Visual comparison pass with disclosed finish limitations; not final approval.
findings.hardware: Brass clasp, round disc, left ring, corner caps and pale irregular feet present consistently. Hinge portions visible in open captures; released upright latch not a proven defect.
findings.terrain: Closed marketing/runtime show pale green meadow panels divided by light irregular stone walls. Ground remains shallow and smooth; upright coping can read as palisade/ruins rather than fine dry-stone craft. Mobile retains wall layout but little relief.
findings.texture_and_promotional_finish: Blue-gray slate palette preserved. Body courses are regular tiled masonry, not fractured slate; inner lid/interior have strong repeated horizontal ridges. Marketing softens these surfaces but does not visibly change main composition. Green seam is decorative reveal, not established living grass.
findings.mobile_and_open_observations: Closed and open model fully contained. Open views reveal hollow slate-colored liner and green rim while landscape top faces away. Small hardware and pale wall details have limited inspection resolution.
limitations: Selective landscape interpretation, not geographic replica or all-UK cultural representation.
Repeated slate banding is a finish caveat, not proven UV corruption or mesh clipping.

findings.verdict_scope: Visual comparison pass with disclosed finish limitations; not final approval.
findings.hardware: Brass corner plates, elongated clasp, round front fitting, left ring and chunky gray-brown feet remain consistent. Open views expose rear hinge portions and released upright latch; no unambiguous detached hardware.

findings.texture_and_promotional_finish: Promotional image has softer salmon/terracotta finish; runtime is warmer ochre with more prominent uniform mottling. Ivory ornament and earthy palette retained. Simplified brick/window repetition and clean brass are finish/stylization limitations rather than geometry failures.
findings.mobile_and_open_observations: Tower silhouettes remain recognizable closed, though window details are dense and brass contrast modest. Open desktop/mobile show textured empty cavity and inner lid; towers are occluded behind raised lid, not demonstrably absent. No obvious silhouette cropping.
limitations: Windows are applied dark inserts, not verified hollow architecture.
No historic/architectural equivalence or rear/underside completeness established.
